outcome: Maternal outcomes (anesthesia type, blood transfusion, length of hospital stay, ICU admission)
Neonatal outcomes (gestational age, birth weight, APGAR scores, ICU admission)
cohort: 363 women with placenta previa who delivered between May 2016 and May 2021.
finding: In women with placenta previa, adverse maternal and neonatal outcomes were increased in cases of emergency cesarean delivery compared to planned cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean delivery was associated with lower gestational age and birth weight, lower APGAR scores, and higher neonatal ICU admission.
gest_age: Gestational age was significantly lower in infants delivered by ECD.
birth_weight: Birth weight was significantly lower in infants delivered by ECD.
